body:
## Pull request overview

This PR renames `ObjectTable` to `ObjectGrid` and refactors it to align with the `@objectstack/spec` view.zod ListView grid type schema. The refactoring introduces enhanced type definitions for data providers, columns, selection, pagination, sorting, and filtering while maintaining full backward compatibility with legacy field names.

**Changes:**
- Component renamed from ObjectTable to ObjectGrid with updated type system
- New ViewData discriminated union supporting three provider modes: object, api, and value
- Enhanced column configuration via ListColumn interface with width, alignment, and type properties
- Structured configuration objects for selection, pagination, sort, and filter
- Comprehensive test suite and migration documentation

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 10 out of 10 changed files in this pull request and generated 4 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/types/src/objectql.ts | Adds new types (ViewData, ListColumn, SelectionConfig, etc.) and renames ObjectTableSchema to ObjectGridSchema with legacy field support |
| packages/types/src/index.ts | Updates exports from ObjectTableSchema to ObjectGridSchema and exports new configuration types |
| packages/plugin-object/src/index.tsx | Renames component exports and registry from ObjectTable to ObjectGrid |
| packages/plugin-object/src/__tests__/ObjectGrid.viewzod.test.tsx | New comprehensive test file covering view.zod alignment features and backward compatibility |
| packages/plugin-object/src/__tests__/ObjectGrid.test.tsx | Updates test file with ObjectGrid naming |
| packages/plugin-object/src/ObjectView.tsx | Updates imports and references from ObjectTable to ObjectGrid |
| packages/plugin-object/src/ObjectTable.tsx | File deleted as part of rename |
| packages/plugin-object/src/ObjectGrid.tsx | New implementation file with enhanced features and backward compatibility logic |
| content/docs/plugins/plugin-object/object-grid.mdx | Updated documentation with new API and examples |
| content/docs/plugins/plugin-object/object-grid-migration.mdx | New migration guide showing before/after examples and gradual adoption strategy |
</details>

The `title` and `description` fields are missing from the ObjectGridSchema interface but are still being used in the codebase:
- ObjectView.tsx lines 193-194 uses `schema.table?.title` and `schema.table?.description`
- ObjectGrid.test.tsx line 77 uses `title: 'Users Table'`
- ObjectGrid.viewzod.test.tsx line 473 uses `title: 'Users Table'`

These fields existed in the old ObjectTableSchema and should be added to the legacy fields section to maintain backward compatibility. They should be marked as deprecated with a note to use `label` for title.

Suggested addition after line 341:
```typescript
/**
 * @deprecated Use label instead
 * Legacy title field
 */
title?: string;

/**
 * @deprecated No direct replacement (consider using label with additional context)
 * Legacy description field
 */
description?: string;
```
```suggestion
  /**
   * @deprecated Use label instead
   * Legacy title field
   */
  title?: string;

  /**
   * @deprecated No direct replacement (consider using label with additional context)
   * Legacy description field
   */
  description?: string;
  
  /**
```

The `api` provider is documented in the migration guide (lines 63-82) and defined in the ViewData type (packages/types/src/objectql.ts lines 62-68), but it's not implemented in the ObjectGrid component. The component only handles `value` and `object` providers.

When a user provides `data: { provider: 'api', read: {...} }`, the component will not fetch data from the API endpoint as documented. The getDataConfig function will return the ViewData object, but the fetchData callback doesn't have logic to handle the 'api' provider case.

The error message displays "Error loading table" but the component is now called ObjectGrid. Consider updating this to "Error loading grid" or "Error loading data" to match the component's new name. ```suggestion

Error loading grid

```
